# AICheck365

> Browser-based AI image and video origin detector. AICheck365 analyzes files locally and looks for metadata, container fields, file-name hints, C2PA/Content Credentials, and sampled video-frame watermark signals.

## Primary Pages

- [AI image/video detector](https://www.aicheck365.com/): Upload an original image or video and inspect AI-origin signals in the browser.
- [Platform guides](https://www.aicheck365.com/platforms/): Common source signals for Gemini, Imagen, DALL-E/GPT Image, Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, Firefly, Flux, ComfyUI, Leonardo, Ideogram, Sora, and Kling.
- [AI video detection guide](https://www.aicheck365.com/blog/how-to-detect-ai-videos/): MP4/MOV metadata, C2PA-lite, SEI marker, file-name hints, and sampled frame watermark checks.
- [AI media metadata guide](https://www.aicheck365.com/blog/ai-image-metadata-guide/): EXIF, XMP, C2PA, PNG tEXt, MP4/MOV, and AI platform writing patterns.
- [What is C2PA](https://www.aicheck365.com/blog/what-is-c2pa/): Content Credentials and provenance signals for AI media.
- [Research Center](https://www.aicheck365.com/research/): Reproducible browser-local provenance experiments with fixture sources, licenses, parser versions, observed signals, misses, and limitations.
- [AI Media Provenance Report, 2026 Q3](https://www.aicheck365.com/research/ai-media-provenance-report-2026-q3/): A dated comparison of 5 experiment records covering 6 tested sample instances across JPEG, PNG, and MP4 fixtures, with a public JSON registry and reproduction notes.
- [Privacy policy](https://www.aicheck365.com/privacy/): Files are analyzed locally in the browser and are not uploaded.

## Platform Guides

- [Gemini AI image/video detection](https://www.aicheck365.com/platforms/gemini/): C2PA Content Credentials, PNG caBX/JUMBF, Google AI fields, MP4/MOV metadata, and filename clues.
- [Google Imagen detection](https://www.aicheck365.com/platforms/imagen/): C2PA, JUMBF, claim_generator_info, digitalSourceType, and Google AI video metadata.
- [DALL-E / GPT Image detection](https://www.aicheck365.com/platforms/dall-e/): OpenAI C2PA metadata, XMP fields, and related Sora video provenance clues.
- [Midjourney detection](https://www.aicheck365.com/platforms/midjourney/): XMP CreatorTool, IPTC digital source fields, and file-name patterns.
- [Stable Diffusion detection](https://www.aicheck365.com/platforms/stable-diffusion/): PNG tEXt chunks, prompts, seeds, workflow metadata, and frame-export clues.
- [Sora video detection](https://www.aicheck365.com/platforms/sora/): Historical-file checks for preserved Sora exports after the Web/App discontinuation, using C2PA clues, MP4/MOV container metadata, file names, and sampled frame watermarks.
- [Kling video detection](https://www.aicheck365.com/platforms/kling/): MP4/MOV metadata, SEI markers, AIGC labels, and video frame watermark signals.

## Useful Facts

- AICheck365 is best used with direct platform downloads or other original files that still retain metadata.
- A missing signal does not prove a file is human-made. Social-media transcoding, screenshots, screen recordings, editor exports, and metadata cleaning can remove provenance signals.
- The browser tool checks images and videos without uploading file contents or detection results to a server.
- Detection is based on readable provenance signals rather than visual guessing alone.
- The tool can inspect images and videos; video frame extraction runs locally and may be slower for large files.
